summary: The change lets an account view, check and rename its creator handle. It covers the control plane, workspace-server forwarding with link refresh, and the account-dialog editor. Released handles stay with their owner through the `app_handle_claims` table, and claimHandle now refuses a handle that another account's creator row holds. All earlier findings are fixed, both test tiers pass and the coverage gate passes. I accept the remaining exemptions: on SQLite, transactions run one at a time, so those lines are reachable only when PostgreSQL writers run concurrently.
